connector.name: Labelgrid MCP
connector.registryDescription: Official LabelGrid MCP server - manage your music catalog, releases, analytics and distribution.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the labelgrid account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LABELGRID_API_TOKEN
env.description: Your LabelGrid API token. Create one in your dashboard under Profile → API Tokens. Without it the server starts in setup mode and walks you through creating one.

env.name: LABELGRID_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the production API.

env.name: LABELGRID_ENABLE_WRITES
env.description: Enable safe writes (create/update drafts, labels, artists, and similar). Enabled by default; set to false for read-only.

env.name: LABELGRID_ENABLE_FULL_WRITES
env.description: Enable full writes (distribution, takedowns, immutable uploads). Disabled by default; also requires LABELGRID_FULL_WRITES_ACK.

env.name: LABELGRID_FULL_WRITES_ACK
env.description: Must equal the exact acknowledgment sentence (see the README safety section) to arm full writes.

env.name: LABELGRID_TOOLSETS
env.description: Comma-separated subset of toolsets to expose (account, reference, catalog, releases, insights, finance, webhooks, distribution; pre-0.3.0 names are accepted as aliases). Defaults to all except webhooks, which must be named explicitly to enable.

env.name: LABELGRID_READ_ONLY
env.description: Force reads only; overrides both write flags. Defaults to false.
